Matching these catalog fieldsEdit in the catalog ↗

All criteria must match. Unknown metadata is not a match. Review model quota, region, permissions, security and charges in the detail page and repository.

Why choices and a text field?

Choices make it easy to start without knowing Azure terminology. Optional free text captures a more specific idea. Editable criteria keep the result understandable. This finder does not pretend to answer deployment, security or cost questions.
